segments.name: Beer
segments.description: Produces and markets imported beer brands and alcohol-by-volume products in the U.S. market.
segments.evidence: We are the #1 brewer and seller of imported beer in the U.S. market. We are also a leader in the high-end segment of the U.S. beer market, which includes the imported and ABA categories.

segments.name: Wine and Spirits
segments.description: Produces and markets exclusively higher-end wine and spirits brands primarily in the U.S. and international markets.
segments.evidence: We are a higher-end wine and spirits company in the U.S. market, with a portfolio that we believe is positioned for long-term growth.

revenueModel.text: Consumers purchase beer, wine, and spirits through wholesale distributors and retailers who are the company's direct customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The strength of our brands makes us a supplier of choice to many of our consumers and our Customers, which include wholesale distributors and retailers.

changes.text: In June 2025, the company sold and licensed trademarks of mainstream wine brands in the Wine and Spirits segment to focus on exclusively higher-end brands.
changes.evidence: June 2025 Sold and, in certain instances, exclusively licensed the trademarks of a portion of our wine and spirits business, primarily centered around our then-owned mainstream wine brands and associated inventory, wineries, vineyards, offices; supported our focus on consumer-led premiumization trends and meeting the evolving needs of consumers.
